intro: Baited for Success involves assisting local fisherman Jason Mathers in dealing with a disruptive murloc infestation. By coordinating with Remy to prepare a targeted poisoned bait, Mathers hopes to clear the waterways and safely resume selling his catch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.
Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
